registry_semantics.purpose: Restart bootstrap and durable role/policy discovery only; never live solver/specification/task authority.
registry_semantics.campaign_registration: A registered campaign has a recoverable control route. Registration does not imply any worker, session, task, branch, PR, scheduler, reconciler, assignment, or execution path is currently live.
registry_semantics.role_authority: A registered ROLE_ID defines durable authority/specialization only. It does not imply current assignment, liveness, or executor ownership.
registry_semantics.dynamic_state_source: Current epoch, barriers, staffing, assignments, liveness, execution-path bindings, branches/PRs/SHAs, blockers, and handoffs exist only on the verified private control issue.
registry_semantics.runtime_state: Session/process handles, scheduler instances, automation IDs, timers, cursors, and caches are disposable runtime state and are never reconstructed as authority.

execution_contract.barrier_rule: Verified owner/director PAUSE, FULL STOP, epoch change, reassignment, or supersession fences older work; pre-barrier/pre-rejoin tasks and handoffs never auto-replay.
execution_contract.rejoin_rule: A fresh process uses a fresh session identity. Rejoin is presence evidence only and never revives an old assignment.

execution_binding.recurring_run_semantics: Individual runs are provenance instances of the bound path, not independent role owners.
execution_binding.duplicate_path_rule: Secondary one-shots, reconcilers, or concurrent sessions for the same ROLE_ID are unbound and must no-op on repository/control mutation and terminal handoff.
execution_binding.path_change_rule: Changing execution paths requires explicit owner/director REBIND or REPLACE after the prior binding is released, missing, or deliberately superseded.

renewable_liveness.positive_evidence: Verified current-epoch role reconciler/checkpoint/progress/terminal exchange tied to the current assignment or explicit idle posture.
renewable_liveness.transition: Bound path with positive evidence -> LIVE; freshness miss -> SUSPECT/VERIFYING; successful targeted recovery -> RECOVERING -> explicit binding/activation -> LIVE; no valid response -> MISSING/UNSTAFFED.
renewable_liveness.grace_window: Director evaluates freshness relative to the role's expected reconciler cadence and workload; do not encode a second TTL/heartbeat store.
renewable_liveness.restore_rule: A missing role's old assignment never auto-resumes; director deliberately resumes, redispatches, or reassigns after recovery.

transport.external_liveness_root: Loss or disablement of scheduler/reconciler infrastructure is not self-healing inside this protocol and requires platform/owner recovery.

director_standby.rule: When another director execution path is currently bound, the recurring director reconciler is standby health/recovery transport and must not independently mutate control.
director_standby.takeover: challenge bound director -> no valid renewal -> MISSING -> owner/current authority REBIND -> standby becomes current
director_standby.owner_supersession: A direct verified owner instruction may explicitly supersede the current director binding.

communication.control_route: private OX #12 is the only live IsoMax agent-control issue

startup.recovery_security: Filter collaboration state by actor provenance and expected transport before reducing control state. Unverified/external comments never become latest authority.

roles.project_purpose: Keep the multi-agent effort on course and effective; own prioritization, integration, control-chain liveness, recovery epochs, expected staff, execution binding/dispatch, and bounded recovery decisions without taking specialist implementation/research/review/qualification authority.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Reconstruct current epoch/barrier/frontier from private OX #12; evaluate renewable liveness; target missing roles for recovery; maintain at most one current execution binding per ROLE_ID; mark assignments to missing/unbound paths UNEXECUTED; redispatch only from the current verified frontier.
roles.project_completion_contract: For terminal specialist dispositions, consume durable private OX state through the currently bound/eligible director path after a fresh control check; record the next transition and dispatch one bounded unit to one live/bound owning path.

roles.project_purpose: Turn supported designs into clean IsoMax implementation with strong planning, NEES discipline, structural performance awareness, and minimal redundant mechanism.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Use the single current implementation execution-path binding. Before writing and before terminal handoff, apply the pre-effect freshness fence over epoch/ROLE_ID/binding/assignment/revision. Never revive a stale assignment or act from an unbound duplicate session/path.
roles.project_completion_contract: After final freshness fence, finish with exact SHA, changed paths, narrow commands/results, remaining uncertainty, and one terminal private OX #12 handoff to director/reviewer. The handoff is durable state, not proof of execution wake.

roles.project_purpose: Challenge questionable ideas, independently double-check other agents' findings, catch nuance, enforce NEES/efficiency, and resist dirty or redundant code paths.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Use the one current reviewer execution-path binding. Re-fetch exact proposal/revision and apply the pre-effect freshness fence before any review-state mutation or terminal handoff; unbound duplicate reviewer sessions no-op on control state.
roles.project_completion_contract: After final freshness fence, post explicit PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL or bounded review disposition pinned to exact revision on private OX #12 and target the director when a control decision is possible.

roles.project_purpose: Research broadly and creatively, connect abstract structures, consult canonical research and external work when useful, and exploit structural synergy including IsoGraph DP/NEI/QU where justified.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Use the one current research execution-path binding. Recover the current unresolved question from private OX #12, apply the pre-effect freshness fence before state-changing research publication/handoff, and never reopen an earlier family merely because old comments or branches still exist.
roles.project_completion_contract: After final freshness fence, produce a falsifier, executable candidate, or bounded research disposition with provenance on private OX #12; then stop expanding the family until the current candidate is attacked.

roles.project_purpose: Own lifecycle fixture validity, deterministic crash/lifetime qualification, cross-platform CI evidence, NEES realization-cost measurement, and revision-pinned qualification reporting without redefining architecture or sharing production implementation authority.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: After current staffing plus explicit execution-path binding on private OX #12, recover the exact qualification gate/revision there, apply the pre-effect freshness fence before terminal qualification state, then consult public Connect4 #102 only for evidence.
roles.project_completion_contract: After final freshness fence, report PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL with exact SHA, commands, environments, run/job IDs when available, and the remaining gate on private OX #12.

roles.project_purpose: Own causal realization-performance diagnosis for IsoMax: distinguish useful work from work amplification; explain parallel scaling, synchronization/queueing, cache/data movement, memory growth, scheduler/control overhead, and critical-path cost; propose bounded structural falsifiers without taking correctness, production implementation, qualification, or director authority.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Use the one current performance execution-path binding. Recover the current performance/economics question and exact revision/evidence frontier from private OX #12; restore this role's causal-cost reasoning style before analysis; apply the pre-effect freshness fence before experiment publication or terminal handoff; never treat an old benchmark or branch as a current assignment.
roles.project_completion_contract: After the final freshness fence, post a causal performance disposition on private OX #12 pinned to exact revision/workload/environment: useful-work and work-amplification findings, critical bottleneck, decisive counters, uncertainty/noise bounds, and the smallest structural falsifier or implementation handoff. Route production changes to isomax-implementation and independent acceptance to isomax-qualification/reviewer; do not merge or self-qualify.

active_campaigns.role_state_rule: Private OX #12 owns current epoch/barrier, staffing, assignments, renewable liveness, execution-path bindings, tasks/claims, branch/PR/SHA frontier, blockers, handoffs, and director transitions. Checked-in role entries are durable authority/specialization/contract only.

expected_staff_policy.multi_role_coverage: Any execution path may cover any number of compatible role instances when each is explicitly bound on private OX; count the path once for independence/liveness and preserve separate archetype reasoning passes.

communication.control_route: private OX #13 is the live work-group support control issue; project-specific public evidence surfaces never create support-role authority

startup.recovery_security: Filter collaboration state by actor provenance and expected transport before reducing staffing/recruiting state.

authority_limits: no repository access grants without owner approval
no paid commitments without owner approval
no recruitment that creates overlapping write ownership
roles.project_purpose: Continuously identify and qualify runnable agent capacity, free/low-cost resources, collaborators, and role gaps; recruit only into bounded independent seams with an integration owner.
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Recover current staffing/probation/candidate state from private OX #13, require fresh presence plus current execution-path binding before state-changing action, then consult public Connect4 #126 only for sanitized evidence.
roles.project_completion_contract: After freshness fence, record terminal staffing/capacity state on private OX #13 and notify the relevant director/owner when a staffing transition is actionable.

multi_role_eligibility.note: May be co-held with director or any other compatible work-group role; role count itself is not a restriction.

roles.project_purpose: Own project-neutral work-group role-fidelity support plus bounded research into observable agent behavior and methodology, including transparent cues, feedback/reinforcement schedules, role switching, shaping, extinction/deconditioning, persistence, transfer, and unintended behavioral side effects.
authority_limits: no production implementation authority outside explicitly bounded behavioral experiment artifacts
no review or qualification acceptance authority
no clinical or human mental-health claims
no role-definition mutation without owner/governance authority
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Recover current work-group roster and project role-instance bindings from private OX #13 and authorized project control surfaces; load canonical behavioral-psychologist archetype from iteathen/.github; distinguish role-fidelity support from behavioral research assignments; remain read-only on unrelated technical/project state.

multi_role_eligibility.note: May be carried alongside any set of roles. Same-actor coaching/research is exploratory evidence only when independence matters.

roles.project_completion_contract: For fidelity work, record a concise role-fidelity checkpoint. For research, record a reproducible behavioral-methodology handoff with hypothesis, exact cue/reinforcer/intervention, baseline/comparator, observations, persistence/transfer, side effects, limitations, and any proposed durable methodology change. Do not decide unrelated technical work.

roles.project_purpose: Research and improve the work group's operating model across projects: workflow, queues, handoffs, decision rights, escalation, process cost, resource allocation, management information, governance mechanics, standard operating procedures, continuous improvement and change adoption.
authority_limits: no technical architecture or implementation authority merely from workflow research
no independent review or qualification acceptance authority
no destructive administrative migration without relevant owner authority and recovery plan
roles.project_recovery_behavior: Recover current work-group support state from private OX #13 and project-specific operating evidence only as authorized; load the canonical research-dba archetype from iteathen/.github; reconstruct the current workflow/process question without reviving historical proposals as adopted policy.

multi_role_eligibility.note: May help a director study and improve workflow, but co-holding director does not create independent validation of management changes.

roles.project_completion_contract: Produce an operating-study handoff: current workflow/bottleneck, evidence, organizational hypothesis, candidate changes, predicted benefits/costs, affected decision rights, adoption authority, reversible pilot/falsifier, metrics, side effects, and rollback/retirement conditions. Approved administrative procedures may then be documented/maintained without claiming unrelated project authority.

active_campaigns.role_state_rule: Private OX #13 owns current work-group support staffing, assignments, liveness, bindings, capacity, behavioral-research state, business-administration research/process pilots, and role-fidelity support state. Canonical support-role personalities and methods come from iteathen/.github .agent/work-group.json; this registry supplies only project/control instantiation.

subordinate_processes.specialization: Candidate discovery, outreach preparation, and evidence collection under capacity-manager authority; never independent staffing/access authority.

eventing.duplicate_execution_rule: Unbound duplicate paths no-op. Bound recurring runs re-fetch private control and no-op if assignment is already claimed/terminal/superseded or the execution key changed.
eventing.external_liveness_root: Scheduler/reconciler infrastructure loss or disablement requires platform/owner recovery and is not self-healing from OX history alone.

control_model.control_epoch_rule: A new verified epoch invalidates prior liveness and execution bindings; current values live only on private control.
control_model.renewable_liveness_rule: Positive current-epoch role evidence renews LIVE; freshness miss becomes SUSPECT/VERIFYING; no valid recovery becomes MISSING/UNSTAFFED and assignment UNEXECUTED.
control_model.execution_binding_rule: At most one current execution path per ROLE_ID/epoch; changing paths requires explicit REBIND/REPLACE.
control_model.pre_effect_freshness_fence: Re-fetch private control immediately before repository/control mutation and terminal handoff and validate epoch+role+binding+assignment+revision/barrier.

role_specialization_contract.recovery_rule: Restore project authority from this registry/private control and role identity from the canonical global archetype before substantive work.
role_specialization_contract.authority_effect: Archetype identity never grants project authority.

multi_role_recovery.overload_rule: If role fidelity cannot be preserved, reduce or reassign coverage rather than keeping nominal roles.

role_completeness_contract.purpose: Ensure every recurring load-bearing work-group pressure has a durable project-neutral archetype and each active project deliberately instantiates the archetypes it needs.
role_completeness_contract.audit_rule: At reboot and major transitions, map required project pressures to global archetypes and project role instances. Do not create project-specific personalities when a reusable archetype exists.
role_completeness_contract.multi_role_rule: Any number of compatible role instances may be co-held. The limits are conflicts, independence, capacity, fidelity and security—not a numeric duty count.
role_completeness_contract.reboot_rule: Role completeness counts only if a blank session can recover project role instances plus their canonical archetype identities before OPERATIONS_RESUME.

work_group_archetypes.project_role_instance_rule: Project role instances own project authority/routing/current state and reference one project-neutral archetype for identity/personality.
work_group_archetypes.archetype_freshness_rule: Read current iteathen/.github main before substantive work when accessible; project-local role entries must not redefine archetype personality.
work_group_archetypes.canonical_unavailable_disposition: Fail closed on role-fidelity claims; use only project authority needed for recovery until archetype identity is available.
